integration_notes: WEB (kernel-services-web agent, web/): 1. Copy docs/identity/{favicon.svg, app-icon.svg, maskable-icon.svg, manifest.webmanifest, icons/} into web/public/ with the layout unchanged. The manifest's icon paths are relative ("app-icon.svg", "icons/icon-512.png"), so the copy stays valid when the manifest is served at /manifest.webmanifest. If vite-plugin-pwa generates the manifest, mirror these fields and icons into its `manifest` option, or set manifest:false and serve this static file. 2. Add to index.html: , , , , and meta theme-color #EEF0F8 (light) and #0B0D1F (dark) using media attributes. 3. Manifest background_color and theme_color are the light-theme --pl-bg #EEF0F8 and --pl-accent #5856D6, as spec §4.5 requires. The boot screen is dark, so an installed app may flash light on its splash; switch background_color to #0B0D1F if that is preferred. UI and boot-ui (ui/, wm/src/boot-ui): 4. The mark is exactly ui/src/icons/atom-logo.ts scaled by 20/3 (two orbits at ±32°, ry/rx 0.4, electron at the tip of the -32° orbit), with the same --pl-logo-* colours. The Stitch boot-splash reference draws THREE orbits at 0/60/120°; the boot screen should use this two-orbit mark so boot, menu bar and kit match. 5. logo.svg can be inlined in index.html for the boot screen (1.25 KB gzipped). Inlined, it reads the --pl-logo-* tokens; its classes and ids use the plt-logo-* and plt-lu-* prefixes to avoid collisions. 6. The wallpapers are the --pl-wallpaper token layers as SVG (2560x1600, preserveAspectRatio slice, gradients only), plus the boot-splash orbit arcs. Use them with object-fit/background-size: cover and aria-hidden. 7. logo-mono.svg uses currentColor, which only works inlined or as a CSS mask; through it renders black. Copy it at build or seed time. Root docs agent: 10. THIRD_PARTY.md already lists @fontsource-variable/inter (OFL-1.1). problems: Spec conflict, needs an owner decision (R3): specs/00-product/identity-and-branding.md §3.6 still describes a different logo, 'a plotted point on an orbit' (an open ring plus a dot). Its rules forbid gradients and filters, require strokes of at least 20 units and forbid a separate simplified favicon. This task, the Stitch references and ui/src/icons/atom-logo.ts all use the luminous two-orbit atom with a soft halo and a dedicated 16 px favicon, and I built to the task and the UI. As a result the planned test 'PLT-ID-03 logo SVGs contain no text, gradient, filter or stroke thinner than 20 units' would fail on logo.svg (it has a gradient and an optional blur filter) and on logo-mono.svg (6-unit strokes at large sizes). The spec and that test should be updated to the atom mark; I cannot edit specs/.
Spec §3.11 points to wm/tokens/tokens.css, but the live tokens file is ui/src/tokens/tokens.css. The kit's colour fallbacks are taken from the latter.

Spec §4.5 lists favicon.svg in the manifest icons. I listed app-icon.svg (any) and maskable-icon.svg (maskable), plus the 192/512 PNGs, because an installed app should show the tile, not the bare mark. favicon.svg is linked from HTML instead.
The docs/identity/README.md mentions a tokens.css copy, which I deliberately did not create (see integration_notes 9), so the kit is missing it until a build or seed step copies it.

The scratchpad generator that produced the SVGs (Python plus fontTools for the wordmark outlines) was not committed. The committed SVGs are the hand-editable source of truth, and render-png.mjs regenerates the PNGs. render-png.mjs does not apply the lossless PNG recompression I ran once, so re-running it gives files about 5-10% larger with the same pixels.
The PNG favicons (16/32) are rendered in the light scheme. On a dark tab strip their contrast is about 2.9:1; favicon.svg itself switches to the dark palette under prefers-color-scheme: dark.
